entities.summary: The Kinuura Rinkai Railway Hekinan Line  is a freight-only railway line owned and operated by the Kinuura Rinkai Railway in Aichi Prefecture, Japan, since 1977. The line extends 8.2 km (5.1 mi) from Higashiura Station Higashiura, Aichi to the terminal at Hekinanshi in Hekinan, Aichi.
